## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change (or it is docs/config only)
- [ ] Docs updated per the table in `AGENTS.md` → "Documentation protocol" (architecture, `.env.example`, roadmap, workspace README)
- [ ] A change to `packages/console` carries a changeset
- [ ] No secrets, account identifiers, internal hostnames, the organization's own work, pricing or production tuning values in the diff
- [ ] Database change is backward compatible with the previous release (expand, then contract)
